title: Ukwihakana hagati mu musesekara
intro: Uca wisanga uri mu bantu amasoko yabo yuzuye ubudandaji, yamara umunzane wabo ukaba utera imbere ata buryarya. Intumwa yarabajeko ibaburira neza, ariko baratwenga, barahindukira, bizigiye uguterimbere kwabo. Ijuru ritangura kwirabura, ariko babona ko ari umuhezagiro w’imvura. None abo bantu ni bande?
clues: Twaratera imbere mu bihugu vy’ubudandaji n’ivy’ubutunzi bwinshi, yamara imitima yacu yaracitse intege.
Intumwa yaje iwacu ifise ibimenyetso bivuye ku Mukama wacu, ariko twatwenga imburi ziwe.
Twari tuzwi cane kubera ubudandaji bwacu, ariko twatanga ingero ngufi kandi tugahenda abantu.
Twaba hagati y’ibiti vyinshi be n’ivyatsi vyizavyiza, mugabo imihezagiro twaronka twayifata minenerwe.
Igihe igicu c’umwirabura cegereje, twaranezerwa, twiyumvira ko kizozana imvura mu bihugu vyacu vyumye.
Ahubwo ico gicu cararekuye igihano gishasha, maze dufatwa n’umubabaro w’umusi w’igitutu.
